title: BIOMASS BRIQUETTING AND PELLETING TECHNOLOGY
alt: Biomass Briquetting and Pelleting Technology at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Biomass briquettes are a bio fuel substitute to coal and charcoal
description: Biomass briquettes are a bio fuel substitute to coal and charcoal made from agricultural and forestry waste where the low-density biomass is converted into high density biomass briquettes.
purpose: Converts low-density agricultural residues and forestry biomass into high-density solid biofuel briquettes to replace coal and charcoal.
industry: Thermal Energy, Biomass Fuel & Industrial Boilers

title: MINI CLONAL PROPAGATION TECHNOLOGY
alt: Mini Clonal Propagation Technology at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Quality planting material and mass multiplication
description: Production of quality planting material and its mass multiplication through mini clonal propagation technology.
purpose: Accelerates the mass multiplication of genetically superior tree cultivars with uniform growth, rapid establishment, and high yield.

title: ACTIVATED CARBON GENERATION
alt: Activated Carbon Generation Unit at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Continuous carbonization from wood species for industrial purposes
description: Generation of Activated Carbon through continous carbonization from wood species which is used for industrial purposes.
purpose: Produces high-grade industrial activated carbon from sustainably sourced wood species via continuous controlled carbonization.
industry: Industrial Filtration, Chemical Processing & Environmental Remediation

title: WOOD SEASONING AND PRESERVATION
alt: Wood Seasoning and Preservation Treatment at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Preserves wood from termite and fungal attack, increasing timber shelf life
description: Preserves wood from termite, fungal attack by removing moisture content and chemical treatment which increases the shelf life of timber.
applications: Moisture Content Reduction & Solar Kiln Drying
purpose: Enhances wood durability, dimensional stability, and longevity by eliminating moisture and applying protective timber treatments.

title: STEAM DISTILLATION FOR ESSENTIAL OILS
alt: Steam Distillation Unit for Essential Oils at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Extraction of essential oils from tree components with wide business scope
description: Extraction of essential oil from tree components through steam distillation method which has a wide scope of business opportunity in local and international markets.
purpose: Efficiently isolates volatile aromatic compounds and pure essential oils from eucalyptus, lemongrass, cymbopogon, and other forestry species.

title: OIL EXTRACTION FROM TREE BORNE OIL SEEDS
alt: Oil Extraction from Tree Borne Oil Seeds at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Oil extraction from TBOs for domestic and industrial utility
description: Extraction of oil from TBOs which have domestic and industrial utility like agriculture, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, bio diesel, etc.,
purpose: Processes non-edible tree-borne oilseeds (Neem, Pongamia, Jatropha, Mahua) into multi-utility industrial oils and nutrient-rich bio-cake.

title: WOOD VALUE ADDITION TECHNOLOGY
alt: Wood Value Addition CNC Router Workshop at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Wood value addition such as antiques and carvings through CNC Router machine
description: Wood value addition such as antiques, carvings, etc through CNC Router machine.
purpose: Empowers entrepreneurs to design, carve, and mass-produce precision 2D/3D wooden artifacts and furniture with high profit margins.

title: TALL SEEDLING PRODUCTION
tagline: Advanced nursery protocols for vigorous tall seedlings
description: Specialized nursery production protocol for cultivating tall, sturdy seedlings (6–10 ft height) with well-developed root architecture for high survival in agroforestry plantations and urban forestry.
purpose: Produces hardened, field-ready tall seedlings that outgrow competing weeds, tolerate browsing pressure, and achieve near-100% field survival.

title: TREE BURLAPPING
alt: Tree Burlapping and Root-Ball Preservation at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Root ball preservation and burlap wrapping for tree transplantation
description: Root ball preservation and burlap wrapping technique for safe transplanting, relocation, and commercial transport of mature trees and seedlings with minimal transplant shock.
applications: Root Ball Stabilization for Long-Distance Transport
purpose: Protects the delicate feeder root system using natural burlap and wire basket binding to ensure seamless transplant survival without root disruption.

title: COCOON CRAFT
alt: Cocoon Craft Silk Value Addition at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Creative value addition using unreelable and pierced silk cocoons
description: Innovative post-cocoon value-addition process utilizing unreelable and pierced silk cocoons for crafting eco-friendly decorative items, floral designs, jewelry, and luxury handicrafts.
purpose: Converts low-value discarded silk cocoons into high-value artisanal luxury products, creating sustainable supplementary rural income.

title: ITK VALIDATION
alt: ITK Validation and Ethno-Botanical Laboratory at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Scientific evaluation and validation of Indigenous Technical Knowledge
description: Scientific evaluation and validation of Indigenous Technical Knowledge (ITK) and traditional ethno-botanical practices to standardize and commercialize herbal and rural innovations.
purpose: Bridges age-old traditional tribal remedies with laboratory analytical validation to formulate certified, repeatable commercial bioproducts.

title: TIMBER DIGITAL TRADE
alt: Timber Digital Trade and Supply Chain Platform at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Digital marketplace connecting tree growers and wood-based industries
description: Digital marketplace and supply-chain platform connecting tree growers, agroforestry farmers, and wood-based industries for transparent pricing, volume estimation, and timber trading.
applications: Mobile Log Volume Measurement & Quality Grading
purpose: Eliminates opaque middlemen in the timber supply chain, enabling tree farmers to receive fair, transparent remuneration.
industry: Digital Agri-Tech, Sawmills, Plywood & Paper Pulp Industries

title: MEDICINAL PRODUCTS
alt: Medicinal Products Processing and Formulation at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Standardized processing and product development from medicinal plants
description: Standardized processing, value addition, and commercial product development from agroforestry and forest-based medicinal and aromatic plants.
purpose: Translates wild and cultivated medicinal botanical species into GMP-compliant powders, decoctions, oils, and standardized pharmaceutical ingredients.

title: NON WOOD FOREST PRODUCTS
alt: Non Wood Forest Products Value Addition at EDII-MAFBIF
tagline: Sustainable collection and value-addition of non-wood forest commodities
description: Sustainable collection, processing, and value-addition of diverse Non-Wood Forest Products (NWFPs) including gums, resins, natural dyes, honey, and forest produce for enterprise development.
purpose: Maximizes sustainable economic returns from forest ecosystems without tree felling through hygienic processing, grading, and packaging of non-wood forest produce.
